verification.note: Twelve content-contract tests, all 160 mathematical expressions with pinned KaTeX, the 128-input baseline check and static build pass. Initial local Chrome inspection showed the concept note, equations and tables at desktop width and 391px; it identified sideways scrolling inside two equations. They were rewritten into shorter aligned steps. After the interrupted run resumed, no preview browser was available, so final mobile fit and review-to-concept navigation were not visually rechecked. No authenticated-production visual check is claimed. All 74 runtime archive files match the checked build byte for byte; the Sites 1.1.7 helper includes the matching manifest at dist/.openai/hosting.json, giving 75 files. The native deployment succeeded as version 8 from the pushed source commit and owner-only access was read back. No training, model experiment, paper replication or scientific qualification was performed.
